name: frogg-de
description: Frogg DE: Tauri desktop client for local and remote AI coding agents (fork of Paseo)

scripts.dev:server:watch: concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue,cyan "npm run watch:protocol" "npm run watch:client" "npm run dev:server:raw"
scripts.build:client:clean: npm run build:protocol:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@getpaseo/client
scripts.build:server-deps: npm run build:client && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names highlight,plugin,relay --prefix-colors yellow,green,blue "npm run build:highlight" "npm run build:plugin" "npm run build:relay"
scripts.build:server-deps:clean: npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:plugin:clean && npm run build:relay:clean
scripts.build:server: npm run build:server-deps && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.build:server:clean: npm run build:server-deps:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run build:clean --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.build:app-deps: npm run build:highlight && npm run build:client && npm run build:plugin && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/expo-two-way-audio
scripts.build:app-deps:clean: npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:plugin:clean && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/expo-two-way-audio
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:ui && npm run build --workspace=@frogg/desktop
scripts.build:desktop:win: npm run build:ui && npm run build:win --workspace=@frogg/desktop
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.version: npm run version:sync-internal && npm run release:prepare && git add -A
scripts.release:check: npm run release:prepare && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/highlight && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/protocol && npm run build:client:clean && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/plugin && npm run build:server:clean && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@getpaseo/cli && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/highlight && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/relay && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/protocol && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/client && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/plugin && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@getpaseo/cli
scripts.release:patch: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:patch && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:minor && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: npm run release:check && npm run version:all:major && npm run release:push
